name: DPM++ 2M CFG++
plain: A CFG++ rewrite of 2M: the exponential term carries the unconditional prediction while the guided x0 is added directly. The second-order correction here takes the difference between the current guided x0 and the previous unconditional x0. So unlike normal 2M it does not shrink to zero on a smooth path when guidance is on.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
t=−log σ, h=t'−t, r=h_last/h.
First step or σ'=0: x'=D+e^{−h}(x−U).
Else: x'=D+e^{−h}(x−U)+(1−e^{−h})/(2r)·(D−U_old).

props.prediction_space: x0 in −log σ, eps from U

label: from code
surprise: Correction term is D−U_old, guided minus previous unguided, so it carries the guidance gap into the extrapolation; plain 2M uses D−D_old.
